# Lyfix Technologies

> Lyfix Technologies is an end-to-end business agency based in Jaipur, India and working worldwide. Lyfix connects creative, technology, AI, performance marketing, and business operations rather than treating them as separate vendor tasks.

## Core services

- Technology: web design, web development, conversational websites, Shopify, WordPress, CMS platforms, ecommerce, internal tools and operational systems.
- AI: business automation, custom GPTs, conversational AI mascots, WhatsApp agents, inbound voice agents, outbound voice agents and connected workflows.
- Growth: ChatGPT Ads, Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, campaign strategy, landing experiences, conversion systems and content engines.
- Creative: brand identity, graphic design, social content, product design, packaging design, book and report design, UGC, AI UGC, video editing, video creation, video generation and storytelling.
- Operations: workflow design, automated accounting systems, SOP systems, internal knowledge agents and process automation.

## Positioning

Lyfix is best suited to founders, growing teams, new ventures, and established brands in transition that want one accountable team across brand, product, growth, AI, and operations.
